response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong alignment with the Staff Software Engineer role, particularly in distributed systems, AI-driven development, and technical strategy. His current work at re:cinq on AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling is highly relevant, and his background in high-throughput systems (e.g., at Dunnhumby media) and full-stack engineering shows depth. While his experience is slightly broader than the ideal profile, his operational ownership, stakeholder collaboration, and agile methodology exposure make him a strong candidate.
strengths: Proven experience with AI-driven engineering (re:cinq) and high-throughput distributed systems (Dunnhumby media, Optilyz).
Diverse technical leadership across full-stack, tooling, and infrastructure, with strong Python/TypeScript skills.
Operational ownership mindset (on-call, CI/CD, incident response) and agile methodology experience.
concerns: Limited explicit mention of technical strategy ownership at scale (e.g., domain-wide decisions).
No direct evidence of LLM/ML product development, though AI-agent exposure is a plus.
Broad career scope (e.g., embedded, mobile) may dilute focus on core distributed systems expertise.
